description: KASPI Global Resource Fabric — Explicit Provider Technical Ceilings & Mitigations

limits.mitigationStrategy: Edge caching for static queries, Dexie client-side caching, background task offloading
All slow database operations (e.g., Z-report rollups) run through streaming chunks or background workers
Mandatory usage of Supavisor connection pooler (?pgbouncer=true&connection_limit=15) supporting 10,000+ multiplexed virtual clients
Next.js connection retry logic + keep-alive health endpoint ping every 4.5 minutes during business hours
Client-side image compression via canvas to WebP < 500 KB before upload
Scoped channels per storeId/tenantId; inactive screens disconnect after 15 minutes of idle time

limits.metric: Gemini Flash Free Tier Rate Limit
limits.mitigationStrategy: Multi-Gateway AI Router automatic failover to Groq LPU, Mistral, and local GPU pool
In-memory sliding-window token bucket in ai-router.ts + failover rotation to secondary key pool
Deploy active background workers (audit log verification, backup integrity checks, metrics collection) to maintain legitimate > 20% baseline activity
